notes: Single deliverable program plus its visible-run artifact: implement exact-integer greedy next-token generation (argmax, lowest-id tie-break, fixed max_new count, context window) over a JSON model, with distractor sampling knobs (temperature/top_k/top_p/repetition_penalty) that must be ignored. Hidden cases probe ties, prompts shorter than ctx, max_new=0, and cyclic repetition, so any sampling deviation or off-by-one count fails. Rubric: reasoning_depth (tie-break + window logic), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (4 distinct hidden models), quantitative_correctness (exact token sequences).
